//: gosec configuration for the ForgeCRM backend. Consumed by the 'Static analysis (gosec)' step in .github/workflows/ci.yml, which runs: gosec -quiet -conf .gosec.json -severity high -confidence medium ./...
//exclusions: G104 (unchecked errors) is excluded globally, and only G104. Its 32 sites are all best-effort cleanup on a path that is already returning an error: os.Remove / os.RemoveAll of a rejected temp file, Close() of a connection or result set that already failed, in-memory bufio.Writer.Flush over a strings.Builder (cannot fail), or best-effort audit records that must not fail the user's action. None can change a security outcome, and go vet / errcheck cover the meaningful ones. No other rule is excluded; every other finding is reported.
